name: Racing Force S.p.A.
note: Racing Force Group, Euronext Growth Milan (RFG; IPO November 2021). Motorsport safety equipment group behind OMP, Bell Helmets, Zeronoise, Racing Spirit and HPS. SAYE S.p.A. holds 49.27% of the share capital, 50.52% is free float; Paolo Delprato, chairman and CEO, is a shareholder and director of SAYE (racingforce.com).
